001package org.clafer.ir;
002
003import java.util.Arrays;
004import org.clafer.common.Check;
005import org.clafer.common.Util;
006import org.clafer.domain.Domain;
007
008/**
009 *
010 * @author jimmy
011 */
012public class IrSetIntersection extends IrAbstractSet {
013
014    private final IrSetExpr[] operands;
015
016    IrSetIntersection(IrSetExpr[] operands, Domain env, Domain ker, Domain card) {
017        super(env, ker, card);
018        this.operands = Check.noNullsNotEmpty(operands);
019    }
020
021    public IrSetExpr[] getOperands() {
022        return operands;
023    }
024
025    @Override
026    public <A, B> B accept(IrSetExprVisitor<A, B> visitor, A a) {
027        return visitor.visit(this, a);
028    }
029
030    @Override
031    public boolean equals(Object obj) {
032        if (obj instanceof IrSetIntersection) {
033            IrSetIntersection other = (IrSetIntersection) obj;
034            return Arrays.equals(operands, other.operands) && super.equals(other);
035        }
036        return false;
037    }
038
039    @Override
040    public int hashCode() {
041        return 3 * Arrays.hashCode(operands);
042    }
043
044    @Override
045    public String toString() {
046        return "(" + Util.intercalate(") ∪ (", operands) + ")";
047    }
048}
